submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint an original native 1254 x 1254 crop of this approved fantasy coastal map. Image 1 is the exact layout crop and controls all silhouettes. Image 2 is the native north strip, matching top 230 pixels; image 3 is the native west strip, matching left 230 pixels. Continue their rock and sand positions precisely. Image 4 shows nearby approved coastline for context and style. This crop is dominated by one huge existing rounded coastal grey boulder: its crown enters near the upper-center, the broad left face is blue-grey shadow, and the broad right shoulder is warm pale grey in sunlight. Only a narrow sliver of golden sand remains along the top, as the guide and north strip show. A tiny white foam tip appears at the very bottom near x=220. Maintain a single broad connected stone body with subtle rounded lobes, not a pile of new small rocks. Fine hand-painted matte mineral texture with restrained detail, soft warm daylight and cool shadows. Preserve elevated map camera, scale and every cropped edge. No new shoreline, buildings, props, vegetation, characters, text, UI or border. Native original detail, not enlarged blur.
